name: empire-war-remastered
description: Empire War Remastered, a personal fork of the Empire at War browser game with a Workshop launcher and Battlefront-style deployment and HUD.

scripts.wasm: asc wasm/pathsearch.ts -o public/js/game/pathsearch.wasm -O3 --runtime stub --noAssert --initialMemory 32 && asc wasm/landpose.ts -o public/js/game/landpose.wasm -O3 --runtime stub --noAssert --initialMemory 2 --enable simd
scripts.test:universal: node tools/test-universal-link.mjs && node tools/test-universal-card-images.mjs && node tools/test-universal-atlas.mjs && node tools/test-universal-combat.mjs && node tools/test-universal-objectives.mjs && node tools/test-campaign-vessels.mjs && node tools/test-universal-flagship.mjs && node tools/test-universal-charters.mjs && node tools/test-universal-campaign.mjs && node tools/test-universal-library.mjs && node tools/test-draw-census.cjs && node tools/test-live-space-trace.cjs && node tools/test-fleet-lod.mjs && node tools/test-universal-mips.mjs
scripts.test:workshop: node tools/test-workshop-order.mjs && node tools/test-workshop-library.mjs && node tools/test-workshop-view.mjs && node tools/test-workshop-battle-art.mjs && node tools/test-briefing-photo-display.mjs
scripts.test:deploy: node tools/test-deploy-framing.mjs && node tools/test-deploy-motion.mjs && node tools/test-deploy-roster.mjs && node tools/test-deploy-disc.mjs && node tools/test-defense-marks.mjs
scripts.test:battlefront: node tools/test-camera-input.mjs && node tools/test-combat-hud.mjs && node tools/test-first-person-kit.mjs && node tools/test-infantry-roll.mjs && node tools/test-shooter-view.mjs && node tools/test-shot-presentation.mjs && node tools/test-shooter-reload.mjs
